rewrites.comment: Cho /api/* di thang toi ham may chu. Phai dat TRUOC luat bat-tat-ca ben duoi vi Vercel xet theo thu tu.

App la dang mot-trang: khong co file that cho /orders/<id>, /tasks/<id>, /company-feed/<id>. Bam vao thong bao day luc app dang DONG thi he dieu hanh mo thang dia chi do -> khong co luat nay se ra 404 trang xoa. Vercel kiem tra file that TRUOC nen assets/*.js, sw.js, version.json van duoc phuc vu binh thuong (da kiem chung: JS van tra ve dung Content-Type).
